_readme: Real testimonials only, published with each person's permission. An entry shows only when 'published' is true. type must be one of: student | customer | partner. Write quotes WITHOUT quotation marks. 'image' is a path WITHOUT extension (no leading slash); loader requests .avif, .webp and .jpg. Omit 'image' to show initials.

testimonials.name: Dan Reynold Ogah
testimonials.quote: ModeInfinity Academy transformed me from a novice with a dream to a master craftsman running a successful workshop. Today, I employ eight talented artisans and we create bespoke pieces for clients worldwide.

testimonials.name: Poki Lengshimwa
testimonials.quote: The advanced techniques and business mentorship I received at ModeInfinity set me apart in London's competitive luxury market. My bespoke pieces are now sought after by international clients and featured in luxury publications.

testimonials.name: Audu Solomon
testimonials.quote: The entrepreneurial program gave me the business acumen to turn my passion for craftsmanship into a thriving international brand. We now export to twelve countries and have created twenty-five local jobs.

testimonials.name: Jaga Nsan
testimonials.quote: The Foundation Mastery program gave me the confidence to start my own bespoke shoe line. The comprehensive curriculum covered everything from leather selection to advanced stitching techniques.

testimonials.name: Ocha Okrie
testimonials.quote: Exceptional mentorship and world-class facilities. I learned more in six weeks than in years of self-study. The academy's focus on sustainable leather practices has helped me create a unique brand identity.

testimonials.name: James Happiness
testimonials.quote: From pattern making to business setup, the academy covers everything. The entrepreneurship module helped me secure funding and establish my international brand.

testimonials.name: Paul Kufre
testimonials.quote: ModeInfinity Academy gave me the discipline and the standard. The teaching is direct, patient, and grounded in real work — not theory.

testimonials.name: Gideon Philip
testimonials.quote: The bar at ModeInfinity is high, and that is exactly what makes the training work. I left with technique, judgment, and the confidence to build at the level I wanted.

testimonials.name: James Uzor
testimonials.quote: ModeInfinity taught me how to make footwear that can compete internationally. The academy's standard raised everything about the way I work.

testimonials.name: Customer Name
testimonials.quote: The fit, the finish, and the detail are immediately obvious. These are shoes made by someone who cares about what they do — and it shows the moment you put them on.

testimonials.name: Customer Name
testimonials.quote: I have commissioned three pairs now. The craftsmanship is consistent, the communication is clear, and the result always exceeds what I imagined.

testimonials.name: Customer Name
testimonials.quote: There is a real difference between footwear made by hand and footwear assembled by machine. ModeInfinity is clearly the former.

testimonials.name: Partner Name
testimonials.quote: Working with ModeInfinity has been straightforward and professional. They take the craft seriously and it shows in everything they deliver.

testimonials.name: Partner Name
testimonials.quote: The quality is consistent, the lead times are honest, and the brand carries itself well with our customers.
